staff.title: Staff & roles
staff.intro: Invite people to help run your shop and choose what each one can do. A cashier can sell at the POS without seeing your costs, settings or other functions. Every change is enforced by the server, not just hidden in the menu.
staff.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the shop? They lose access right away.
staff.noMembersText: Create an invite link and send it to the person who will work with you.
staff.inviteHelp: Create a one-time link and send it by WhatsApp, Messenger or any chat. The person signs in (or creates an account) and joins with the role you chose.
staff.linkOnce: Works once. Anyone with the link can join, so send it only to that person.
staff.inviteMessage: You're invited to join {shop} on zaokaiy as {role}. Open this link to accept: {link}
staff.rolesHelp: A role is a set of permissions. Change a role and everyone with it gets the change.
staff.ownerOnly: Only you (the owner) can manage staff, verify the business and change the shop type.

permHelp.stats: Sales figures and the overview page.
permHelp.products: Add and edit products, prices, categories and barcodes.
permHelp.inventory: Restock and adjust stock, see movements.
permHelp.media: Upload and manage photos and videos.
permHelp.orders: See online orders, ship and complete them.
permHelp.delivery: Courier settings, COD ledger and COD risk reports.
permHelp.pos: Sell, park several bills, print receipts and invoices.
permHelp.pos_void: Cancel a finished counter sale (stock goes back).
permHelp.social: Run lives and handle comment / chat orders.
permHelp.leads: Answer test drives, offers and reservations.
permHelp.marketing: Ad campaigns, creator content, AI assistant.
permHelp.settings: Shop name, logo, description, tax and receipt details.

staff.noAccessText: Your role "{role}" doesn't include any dashboard page yet. Ask the shop owner to give you permissions.

join.title: Join a shop
join.signInFirst: Sign in or create an account to join.

state.used: This invite link has already been used.
state.expired: This invite link has expired. Ask the shop for a new one.
state.revoked: This invite link was cancelled by the shop.

join.notFoundText: Check the link, or ask the shop to send a new one.
